Authenticate is an identity verification platform that confirms a person is real and who they claim to be, then checks the criminal, driving, employment and education records behind the name. One provider instead of two.

An animated verification: a government ID is scanned, its details are checked against identity sources and background records, and the result resolves to a confidence rating of 99 with a low risk assessment.

Contact Us
16,000+ Passports & IDs Worldwide
Instant forensic analysis of 16,000+ government IDs from 254 countries and territories in 38 languages.
 Multiple Verification Options
Optional facial recognition, active & or passive liveness detection & optional additional verification methods including knowledge based authentication, financial account ownership verification, or multi-factor authentication.
$0 Setup Fee & No Long Term Contract
Get started with a $100 deposit for utilization credit. Draw down your balance over time and auto-replenish when empty.
 Automate Background Verifications
Include national criminal background, sex offender registry, and global watch list checks as well as education, employment and professional license verification.
